title: Higgs and Bark backends ignore voice_id, silently dropping a named voice
description:
Same class of bug as auritus-d84350 (fixed in PR #77 for Fish, Chatterbox and F5 only).

PROBLEM
A job that names a voice (for example voice_id=serious) completes status=done in the backend's default voice when its backend is Higgs or Bark, because neither honors voice_id.
- cli/src/auritus/tts/higgs.py: HiggsBackend.generate() calls resolve_higgs_voice(meta) at lines ~112 and ~180 and immediately discards it (`_ = voice`). The named voice never reaches the model.
- cli/src/auritus/tts/bark.py: BarkBackend.generate() never reads meta['voice_id'] at all.
Neither uses the shared lookup in cli/src/auritus/tts/voices.py (require_reference_audio, VoiceNotFound), which Fish/Chatterbox/F5 now use.

EXPECTED
A named voice fails loudly with VoiceNotFound on any backend that cannot honor it, before any model loads, so the local worker (cli/src/auritus/worker/daemon.py) and Batch runner (worker-image/src/runner.py) mark the job failed. Requests with no voice, 'default', or the backend's own default id must still succeed in the stock voice. Decide per backend: either implement cloning via voices.py, or reject any non-default voice_id (a named voice the backend cannot honor is an error either way). Note the router (cdk/lambdas/operator_auth_layer/python/auritus_content_hash.py resolve_voice_id) returns the raw voice or 'default' for these backends.

APPROACH
Start in features/named_voices.feature (add Higgs and Bark to the scenario outlines; see features/steps/named_voice_steps.py), then implement. Reuse VoiceNotFound; do not add a second error type.

REFERENCES
auritus-d84350, PR #77 (merge a8a3729).

comments.text: Fixed in the M3 PR 2b (branch feat/m3-named-voices): Higgs and Bark now fail a named voice with VoiceNotFound before any model loads, and published cloned voices reach Batch through the content store. Close when that PR merges.
